findings.reason: The cited evidence shows local degradation on CORE-DNS-01 but does not support the claim of 'nationwide' impact.
T2 shows resolution_ms and query_success_pct deviations, and ANM-000322 confirms the query success drop.
T3 and ALM-000525 confirm a major DNS_TIMEOUT_RATE alarm on CORE-DNS-01 from 10:52 to 12:05.
T5 explicitly states no changes on CORE-DNS-01 and its parents in the specified time window.
T6 explicitly states no maintenance window was scheduled on CORE-DNS-01 and its parents.
T9 explicitly states no external events were found for all regions in the specified time window.
